data.one_liner: Wrapper for Apple HealthKit and Google Health Connect for reading and writing health data.
data.what_it_does: It provides a single unified Dart API to handle permissions, read typed health data, aggregate time intervals, and write workouts, sleep, and fitness records across both iOS and Android platforms.
use_when: You need to read or write health and fitness data from Apple HealthKit or Google Health Connect.
Your app tracks workouts, steps, sleep, mindfulness, or other biometric metrics.
avoid_when: You only need general device information or sensors not related to HealthKit/Health Connect.
You are targeting older Android versions that do not support Health Connect and cannot guide users to install it.
strengths: Covers both iOS (HealthKit) and Android (Health Connect) behind a single API.
Supports paged, off-UI-thread data reading for large time ranges.
Extensive support for structured health records like workouts, sleep sessions, and vital signs.
weaknesses: Requires manual native platform setup including Android permissions, intent filters, and specific API/Gradle versions.
Android requires the external Health Connect app on devices running Android 13 and lower.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 37, AGP 9.1.0+, Gradle 9.3.1+, configuring permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and adding Health Connect queries/intent filters.
